doc: Timbre drift across separate lines, stitched or not (research-v2/14). TEST MATERIAL ONLY, not the film's narration script.

lines.text: We used to write with nine keys.
One thumb. One press per letter.
Then glass replaced the keys, and the keypad went quiet.
But old is not the same as bad.
Now the same nine keys can speak.
Every spoken word matches the keys you pressed.
It works offline, in your browser, for free.

modes.independent: each line its own request, same seed
modes.stitched: previous_request_ids = up to the last 3 request ids of the same act (Act 2 starts fresh, so the hushed Act 1 delivery does not carry over)
